lead_time: Forecast at start of forthcoming hour; assume last completed hour is available immediately
operational_training_scope: Train a separate model per site; never pool these per-site split files into a chronological backtest
evaluation_mode: Sequential one-hour forecast; earlier observed validation/test power may enter later lag features, never fitting parameters
split: First 70%, next 15%, final 15% of each full calendar; floor boundaries before quality filtering
preprocessing: Fit medians and scaling on eligible train rows only; drop all-missing train features; retain missing indicators for history features
historical_holdout_caveat: These campaigns and prior baseline errors have been inspected; no fresh blind external test set is available
preconstruction_status: Bugesera table unlabelled; do not join it to KIT outcomes
growth_status: No empirical multi-year growth labels; template is empty
measurement_scope: Measured delivered active power; not unconstrained demand, billing energy, or capacity sizing
